meta.title: About NIPKaart
meta.description: NIPKaart brings disabled parking spaces, local rules and garage occupancy together in one place. See where the data comes from and how current it is.

title: Know where you can park before you leave
intro: NIPKaart brings disabled parking spaces, local rules and garage occupancy together in one place. For everyone with a disabled parking card, and for those travelling with them.

sources.title: Where the data comes from
sources.intro: Every parking space shows where its information comes from.

municipal.name: Municipalities
municipal.shows: Official disabled parking spaces, with orientation, number of bays and time windows when the municipality shares them.
municipal.freshness: Updated when the municipality shares new data.

community.name: Community
community.shows: Parking spaces that are not (yet) in open data. Other users can confirm that a parking space is still there.
community.freshness: Updated as users add or confirm parking spaces.

offstreet.name: Garages and P+R
offstreet.shows: The number of free spaces in the whole garage, not specifically the disabled spaces.
offstreet.freshness: Updated every few minutes, with the time of the latest measurement.

why.title: Why NIPKaart exists
body: With a disabled parking card you want to know beforehand whether there is a space, and under which conditions. That information often exists, but it is scattered across municipal datasets, signs and garage websites.

NIPKaart started in 2021 as a geoweb project during studies. Since 2022 we have been collecting data from across Europe. With this new website we are modernising the whole platform: searching starts at your destination, and every parking space shows where its information comes from.

open_source.title: Open source
open_source.text: NIPKaart's code is public on GitHub. Report a bug there or help shape new features.

disclaimer.title: Always check the signs
disclaimer.text: The information on NIPKaart is indicative. What the signs on site say is what applies. No rights can be derived from the data.
